body.name: Ordinary full-kernel batch embedding \(\iota\) on \(\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\)
body.construction:
For \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}=(G,S_0,(\kappa_v)_{v\in V})\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\), let \(\iota(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}})\) have target batch \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{batch}}(S_0)\) and let \(G^{+}\) retain the ordinary node mechanisms.  The catalogue contains a mandatory fresh-unit SELECT \(s\) of cost zero; for each \(v\in V\), a RAND action \(r_v\), of cost \(\kappa_v\), that draws uniformly and independently from \(\mathfrak X_v\) and affects the ordinary children of \(v\); and a zero-cost READ \(\rho_v\) with endpoint \(v\).  SELECT precedes every action, the remaining actions follow canonical causal order, and there are no conflicts or CTF-RAND actions.  For \(B\subseteq V\), put
\[
 S_B=\{s\}\cup\{r_v:v\in B\}\cup\{\rho_v:v\in V\}.
\]
Conditioning its RAND labels on \(b\in\mathfrak X_B\) yields \(P_b(V\setminus B)\), with label probability \(\prod_{v\in B}|\mathfrak X_v|^{-1}>0\), measured ancestry because every vertex is READ, and protocol cost \(\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v\).  The oracle supplies an immutable handle and exact support table for each such law.  Oracle replies outside this SELECT--RAND--READ image are irrelevant.
